تستأذنوا (form X)
# تَسْتَأْذِنُوا (tastaʔḏinū) /tas.taʔ.ði.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْذَنَ (istaʔḏana)
# تُسْتَأْذَنُوا (tustaʔḏanū) /tus.taʔ.ða.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْذَنَ (istaʔḏana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
